answer: Sybil resistance binds every identity to bonded collateral and correlates equivocation across the network. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting statements, their joint penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), through cross-account slashing rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss makes the swarm uneconomic; even an umber relic routed through a jetty of aliases cannot evade attribution, escrow seizure, or asymmetric depreciation.
